digest.headline: 今日 arXiv 理论计算机科学更新聚焦于公平分配与聚类算法、在线模型及计算复杂性下界。
digest.summary: 本日论文在公平性机制设计、在线算法以及复杂性理论等方向均有分布。其中公平聚类与图上公平分配占据了显著位置，同时涉及 Cell-Probe 下界与随机序在线着色等经典主题。总体而言主题分布较为平稳，算法公平性与复杂性证明是当天的核心看点。

themes.name: 公平分配与公平算法
themes.note: 由 Socially Fair Clustering 以及两篇关于图和布尔估值的 Fair Division 论文共同构成。

themes.name: 在线算法与随机模型
themes.note: 包含带有预视机制的对抗在线分类与随机顺序模型下的 FirstFit 在线图着色研究。

themes.name: 计算复杂性与结构下界
themes.note: 涵盖 Frobenius 问题的 Sigma_2^P 完备性分析、Parsing Grammars 的 Cell-Probe 下界及贝叶斯信号处理复杂性。

papers.title: Socially Fair Clustering: Parameterized Approximation and Local Search
papers.abstract: We study the Socially Fair Clustering problem introduced by Abbasi, Bhaskara, and Venkatasubramanian (2021) and Ghadiri, Samadi, and Vempala (2021), along with its extension, the $(p,q)$-Socially Fair Clustering problem. This problem generalizes $k$-medians and $k$-means to settings where data points are partitioned into $\ell$ groups, and the goal is to find a fair clustering that is simultaneously good for all groups. We present several algorithms for this problem. For $\ell_p$-Socially Fair Clustering, we give the first constant-factor FPT-approximation parameterized by the number of groups $\ell$, resolving the open question raised by Ghadiri, Singh, and Vempala (2022). Our main ingredient is a new algorithm for closing additional centers in parameterized time inspired by local search. We then turn to the more general $(p,q)$-Socially Fair Clustering problem. The known algorithm for this problem, proposed by Chlamtáč, Makarychev, and Vakilian (2022) achieves a very good approximation but is complex, slow and difficult to implement. We analyze the performance of a simple local search algorithm and show that it provides an $O(q)$ approximation in the worst case. Finally, we design approximation algorithms for the facility location variant of the problem, where the number of facilities (centers) is not fixed in advance, and opening each facility incurs an opening cost. Unlike in previous work, we do not assume these opening costs are the same for all groups.

notes: Yury Makarychev 在五大会议有 35 篇

analysis.result: 针对l_p-社会公平聚类问题，本文给出了首个以组数l为参数的常数因子FPT近似算法，解决了Ghadiri等人(2022)提出的公开问题；针对(p,q)-社会公平聚类问题，证明了简单的局部搜索算法可提供O(q)最坏情况近似比，并设计了允许各组开辟成本不同的设施选址变体近似算法。
analysis.method: 关键技术手段是受局部搜索启发、用于在参数化时间内关闭额外中心的新算法。
analysis.significance: 解决了Ghadiri等人(2022)关于是否存在以组数为参数的常数因子FPT近似算法的公开问题，并为原先复杂且难以实现的(p,q)-社会公平聚类问题提供了简单实用的局部搜索算法。

papers.title: Fair Division of Graphs: Beyond Traceability
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study fair division problems in which resources are structured as graphs and agents must receive connected bundles. This connectivity requirement fundamentally alters the problem, making it significantly more challenging than its classical counterpart. We focus on the fairness notion of $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$, where envy can be eliminated by removing at most one vertex whose deletion does not disconnect the bundle -- a critical constraint for applications such as land division and network allocation. Our first result extends prior work by establishing the existence of $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ allocations for an infinite family of non-traceable graphs (that is, graphs that do not admit a Hamiltonian path), answering a central open question and generalizing Bilò et al.'s result for traceable graphs. We then make progress on a conjecture concerning the $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ spectrum of trees due to Chen and Zwicker. Finally, we complement our structural results with algorithmic insights, showing that deciding the existence of an $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ allocation is NP-complete even for binary additive valuations, thereby resolving an open complexity question. Taken together, our results deepen the connection between graph theory and fair division, and offer new tools for studying fairness in structured resource environments.

notes: Nicolas Bousquet 在五大会议有 4 篇

analysis.result: 本文证明了一类无限非可追溯图上必定存在 $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ 分配；针对 Chen 和 Zwicker 关于树的 $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ 谱猜想取得了进展；并证明了即使在二值加性估值下，判定是否存在 $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ 分配也是 NP-完全的。
analysis.significance: 本文回答了图上公平分配领域的关键公开问题，将已有结果推广到了非可追溯图上，并解决了该问题在二值加性估值下的复杂度瓶颈。

papers.title: Separating Parsing Expression Grammars using Cell-Probe Lower Bounds
papers.abstract: We resolve three open problems concerning parsing expression grammars (PEGs). We construct a single language $C$ satisfying $C\in\mathsf{LIN}\cap\mathsf{PEG}$ and $C^R\in\mathsf{LIN}\setminus\mathsf{PEG}$. This proves that some linear context-free language is not a PEG language and that PEG languages are not closed under reversal, confirming a conjecture of Loff, Moreira, and Reis. Factoring the same witness resolves the concatenation-closure problem of Rubtsov and Chudinov negatively, in the strong form $\mathsf{PEG}\cdot\mathsf{REG}\not\subseteq\mathsf{PEG}$ despite $\mathsf{REG}\cdot\mathsf{PEG}\subseteq\mathsf{PEG}$. It also refutes closure under Kleene star, homomorphisms, and substitutions. Our main technique converts scaffolding automata (SCAs), which characterize reversals of PEG languages, into dynamic data structures in the cell-probe model. For any suitably local serialization of a problem with preprocessing, updates, and a final Boolean query, an SCA recognizer yields an exact deterministic cell-probe data structure whose operation costs are proportional to the corresponding encoding lengths. Cell-probe lower bounds can therefore prove SCA non-membership and, by reversal, PEG non-membership. We apply this transfer to Multiphase Inner Product using one-symbol update blocks and a query suffix of length $O(\log n)$, while keeping both the language and its reversal linear context-free. Ko's cell-probe lower bound then yields the witness above. The arguments are additionally formalized in Lean 4.

analysis.result: 本文通过构造语言 $C \in \mathsf{LIN} \cap \mathsf{PEG}$ 且其反转 $C^R \in \mathsf{LIN} \setminus \mathsf{PEG}$，证明了线性上下文无关语言不包含于 PEG 语言且 PEG 语言对反转不封闭；同时证明了 $\mathsf{PEG}\cdot\mathsf{REG}\not\subseteq\mathsf{PEG}$，并否定了 PEG 对 Kleene 星号、同态和替换运算的封闭性。
analysis.method: 将刻画 PEG 反转语言的脚手架自动机（SCA）转换为 Cell-Probe 模型中的动态数据结构，并结合 Multiphase Inner Product 问题的 Cell-Probe 下界来导出非归属判定。
analysis.significance: 解决了关于 PEG 语言反转封闭性猜想及拼接封闭性等多个公开问题，并建立了语言表达能力下界与数据结构 Cell-Probe 下界之间的深层联系。

papers.title: Adversarial Online Classification with a Preview
papers.abstract: Worst-case online classification is governed by sequential complexity, such as Littlestone dimension, and can be impossible even for statistically simple classes, such as thresholds of VC dimension one. We study a preview model in which an oblivious adversary fixes an entire labeled sequence of length $T$, a uniformly random subset of size $pT$ is revealed before prediction begins, and the remaining $(1-p)T$ examples are then presented in their original adversarial order. Against the best full-sequence hypothesis evaluated on the unrevealed examples, we characterize the dependence on the preview rate $p$: for binary classes of VC dimension $d$, the optimal excess loss is $Θ(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$, up to the trivial cap at $T$; for multiclass classes we obtain the corresponding $\widetilde O(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$ bound with no dependence on the number of labels. Thus a random preview can replace worst-case sequential complexity by classical statistical dimensions without randomizing the online order. To achieve the sharp binary bound, our ChainedPrediction algorithm uses an online analogue of chaining, implemented as a multiscale aggregation algorithm rather than only as an analytic argument.

notes: Sahil Singla 在五大会议有 29 篇

analysis.result: 在包含大小为pT的均匀随机预览模型的对抗在线分类中，证明了VC维数为d的二分类类的最优超额损失为$\Theta(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$，并将界推广至不依赖标签数量的多分类场景（$\widetilde O(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$）。
analysis.method: 提出了ChainedPrediction算法，将链化（chaining）分析方法在线化并实现为多尺度聚合算法（multiscale aggregation algorithm）。
analysis.significance: 证明了仅需提前随机预览少部分样本，即可用VC维等经典统计维度替代Littlestone维等最坏情况序列复杂度，且无需改变剩余样本的对抗顺序。

papers.title: Fair Division Under Boolean Valuations: Beyond Normalization
papers.abstract: We study fair division of indivisible items when agents have arbitrary two-level preferences: the value of each agent for any set of items is Boolean, which need not be monotone or additive. Notably, we do not impose the standard assumption of normalization, i.e., different agents may value the empty set at different Boolean levels. Since the preferences are nonmonotone, envy-freeness up to one item (EF1) and envy-freeness up to any item (EFX) each admit several variants, depending on which items are tested for removal and whether they are removed from the envious agent's bundle or the envied agent's bundle. This paper investigates the existence of these variants of EF1 and EFX, on their own and together with economic efficiency, incentive compatibility, feasibility constraints, and lottery-based randomization. Our results highlight that the existence landscape depends crucially on the number of normalized agents, who value the empty bundle at the lower Boolean level. The authors used significant assistance from GPT-5.6-Sol for deriving theoretical results, verified any AI-generated proofs for correctness, and expanded on the exposition and simplified arguments, with the aid of GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude Opus 5.

notes: Nisarg Shah 在五大会议有 15 篇

analysis.result: 本文研究了无归一化且非单调的双值（Boolean）估值下不可分物品的公平分配问题，分析了EF1与EFX的多种变体单独或与经济效率、激励相容性、可行性约束及随机化结合时的存在性，表明其存在性格局关键取决于对空集估值为低级别的归一化智能体数量。
analysis.significance: 放宽了传统公平分配中的归一化与单调性假设，揭示了非单调Boolean偏好下各种EF1/EFX变体及其与其他经济性质结合的界限。

papers.title: On the Complexity of Bayesian Signal Processing
papers.abstract: We develop a computational framework for Bayesian decision-making. We show that as long as no action is optimal in every state, Bayes-optimal choice is intractable. This hardness need not arise from large action, state, or signal spaces, nor from a complicated represented utility function: extracting enough information from a hard-to-interpret signal to act optimally can itself be computationally hard. We also characterize tractability across approximation notions and identify their sources of difficulty. Under the probably approximately correct criterion, sample-based Bayesian learning is tractable if and only if the signal support is bounded. Our results provide justifications for bounded rationality, costly Bayesian inference, and sample-based Bayesian learning.

analysis.result: 论文建立了一个贝叶斯决策的计算框架，证明了只要不存在在所有状态下都最优的动作，贝叶斯最优选择就是不可解的（intractable）；并证明在概率近似正确（PAC）标准下，基于样本的贝叶斯学习可解当且仅当信号支撑集是有界的。
analysis.significance: 从计算复杂性角度解释了难以解释的信号如何带来计算困难，为有限理性、有成本的贝叶斯推断及基于样本的贝叶斯学习提供了复杂性理论支撑。

papers.title: FirstFit online coloring in the random order model
papers.abstract: The average performance of FirstFit online coloring on trees in the random order model is completely determined in recent works of Frei et al. and Bosek et al., showing $Θ(\log n /\log\log n)$ number of colors, improving the $Θ(\log n)$ colors in the adversarial model. We provide a few further results on slightly more general graph classes. Firstly, we extend their method to obtain a simple path-counting principle for sparse graph classes, which immediately yields for example that cactus graphs and uniform hypertrees exhibit a similar improvement. We then show that FirstFit uses only $O(1)$ colors on crown graphs, a standard example where adversarial arrival forces $Θ(n)$ colors. We further show that density alone (even linear minimum degree) is insufficient to guarantee $O(1)$ colors even on bipartite graphs. Finally, we identify graph classes, including unit interval graphs and some graphs of high chromatic number, for which random arrival provides only limited improvement. We end with some open problems.

analysis.result: 论文将树上随机到达模型下 FirstFit 在线着色的方法推广到稀疏图类（仙人掌图和均匀超树同样达到 Θ(log n / log log n) 颜色数），证明皇冠图在随机到达下所需颜色数从对抗模型的 Θ(n) 降至 O(1)，并证明即便在具有线性最小度的二分图上密度本身也不足以保证 O(1) 颜色数。
analysis.method: 将前人针对树的分析方法推广，建立了一套适用于稀疏图类的简单路径计数原则（path-counting principle）。
analysis.significance: 系统拓展了随机到达模型下 FirstFit 在线着色的理论图类边界，不仅给出了多类图上的正向改进结果，还明确指出了单纯依靠密度或在单位区间图等特定图类中随机到达所能带来的改进局限。

papers.title: A General Plotkin-type Bound on Function-Correcting Codes with Wyner-Graham Distance
papers.abstract: Function correcting codes (FCCs) are designed to protect a specified function evaluation of messages at a higher level than the level of protection for messages, against errors while reducing the redundancy required for reliable communication. FCCs have thus far been studied for channels matched to various distances, including the Hamming and Lee distances. Every function partitions the message space into preimage sets corresponding to its distinct function values. Existing Plotkin-type bounds on the optimal redundancy of FCCs under the studied distances, applicable to arbitrary functions on the message space, depend on the pairwise distances among all the message vectors. This makes these bounds difficult to compute. We derive a general Plotkin-type bound on the optimal redundancy of FCCs under Wyner Graham distances, which include the Hamming and Lee distances as special cases. Our bound depends only on the cardinalities of the preimage sets and the sum of pairwise distances only among vectors within each preimage set. This approach significantly reduces the computations required to evaluate the existing Plotkin-type bounds and yields simplified bounds that are easier to compute for specific functions. We obtain simplified Plotkin-type bound for linear functions under the Wyner-Graham distance. Furthermore, the existing simplified bounds for linear functions under the Hamming and Lee distances are recovered as special cases of the proposed bound. We also obtain simplified bounds for several important classes of functions, including the Hamming weight function, the Hamming weight distribution function, the monomial functions under the Hamming distance, and the modular sum function, the Lee weight function, and the Lee weight distribution function under the Lee distance.

analysis.result: 论文推导了 Wyner-Graham 距离（涵盖 Hamming 与 Lee 距离）下函数纠错码（FCC）最优冗余量的通用 Plotkin 型界，将原界对全体消息向量对距离的依赖简化为仅依赖各原像集基数及原像内部向量对的距离和，并给出线性函数、Hamming/Lee 重量及分布函数等多类函数的具体化简界。
analysis.method: 将界计算中所有消息向量对的距离和化简为仅在各原像集内部计算向量对距离和，从而推导 Wyner-Graham 距离下的 Plotkin 型界。
analysis.significance: 统一并推广了已有的 Hamming 和 Lee 距离下的 Plotkin 型界，显著降低了计算任意函数纠错码最优冗余量界限所需的计算复杂度。

papers.title: Combinatorial maps for hierarchical splines
papers.abstract: Hierarchical splines are an important part of multiscale and adaptive isogeometric analysis formulations. The Bézier meshes of these splines are an essential part of their definition and of several important hierarchical spline algorithms, such as adaptive refinement and Bézier extraction. Topological data associated with the Bézier mesh-such as adjacency information-can be used to improve the performance of many of these algorithms as well as downstream applications of the splines, but typical hierarchical spline formulations do not compute the topological data, storing instead just a list of elements. In this work we present algorithms to build a performant topological data structure, namely the combinatorial map, to represent Bézier meshes of hierarchical splines over cubical cell complexes where the refinement levels have conforming Bézier meshes. This includes hierarchical and truncated hierarchical B-splines, as well as subsets of other hierarchical spline formulations. We show the performance characteristics of the construction algorithms of these hierarchical combinatorial maps, as well as an example use case, showing that the topological information can provide up to an order of magnitude reduction in computation time in downstream applications of the splines.

analysis.result: 论文提出了为立方胞腔复形上的分层样条（要求各精细层具有符合性Bézier网格）构建组合地图（combinatorial map）拓扑数据结构的算法，并在下游应用中实现了最高达一个数量级的计算时间缩减。
analysis.method: 构建并维护表示分层样条Bézier网格拓扑邻接关系的组合地图数据结构。
analysis.significance: 解决了传统分层样条表示仅存储元素列表而缺失拓扑邻接信息的问题，显著提升了后续算法的性能，但适用范围局限于精细层网格符合的立方胞腔复形。

papers.title: The Complexity of Coverability-Like Problems in Elementary Object Systems: Data-Nets to the Rescue
papers.abstract: Elementary Object Systems (EOSs) are a model in the nets-within-nets (NWNs) paradigm, where tokens in turn can host standard Petri nets. We study the complexity of coverability-like problems, including termination and boundedness, over EOSs. Since coverability and boundedness are undecidable in general on EOSs, we focus on the relevant fragment of conservative EOSs (cEOSs). Our technique interprets cEOSs into the framework of data nets, whose tokens carry data from an infinite domain, thus bridging the nesting and the data-aware paradigms. Specifically, we show that cEOS coverability-like problems are equivalent to the coverability-like problems over an interesting fragment, called channel-$ν$PNs (c-$ν$PNs), of data nets that extends $ν$PN (featuring globally fresh name creation) with restricted forms of transfers with renaming. c-$ν$PNs remain less expressive than Unordered Data Nets, which feature lossy name creation as well as powerful forms of whole-place operations and broadcasts. These reductions allow us to analyze cEOS coverability taking advantage of known results on data nets. We conclude that the complexity of cEOS coverability is double-Ackermanian, $\mathcal{F}_{ω2}$-complete, while termination and boundedness are non-primitive recursive.

analysis.result: 证明了保守基本对象系统（cEOS）上的可覆盖性问题是 double-Ackermanian 且 F_{ω2}-完备的，而其终止性和有界性问题是非原始递归的。
analysis.method: 将 cEOS 约简并解释为数据网（data nets）的一个扩展片段 channel-νPNs（c-νPNs），借用数据网领域的已知结果进行复杂性分析。
analysis.significance: 建立了嵌套网（nets-within-nets）范式与数据感知（data-aware）范式之间的桥梁，确立了 cEOS 模型下可覆盖性及相关问题精确的计算复杂度界限。

papers.title: A unified geometric design framework for kirigami structures
papers.abstract: In recent years, kirigami metamaterials have been widely studied and applied in science and engineering. While various two- and three-dimensional kirigami design methods have been developed, most of them are only applicable to a limited class of kirigami structures. In this work, we develop a unified framework for kirigami design that encompasses a wide range of 2D-to-2D, 2D-to-3D, and 3D-to-3D shape-morphing effects, as well as additional geometric and physical properties such as compact reconfigurability and rigid deployability. In particular, by reformulating the design task as a length-based constrained optimization problem and solving it simultaneously for multiple target states of the kirigami structure, our unified design framework enables greater design flexibility and stronger theoretical support. Experimental results with a wide range of shape-morphing effects are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. We further present a rigorous theoretical analysis of several key aspects of kirigami design, covering inertia transposition, aspect-ratio law, and angle defects, thereby elucidating important design rules and limitations. Altogether, our work paves a new way for the design of shape-morphing mechanical metamaterials.

analysis.result: 提出了涵盖 2D-to-2D、2D-to-3D 及 3D-to-3D 等多种形变效应的剪纸结构统一设计框架，并对剪纸设计中的惯性转置、长宽比定律和角缺陷等理论要素给出了严格的数学分析与设计局限说明。
analysis.method: 将剪纸设计任务重新表述为基于边长的约束优化问题，并针对结构的多个目标状态进行同步求解。
analysis.significance: 克服了以往剪纸设计方法仅适用于特定结构类别的局限，为多状态形变及物理性质提供了统一的设计工具与理论支持；但对于理论计算机科学核心领域而言，偏向计算几何与物理超材料的应用结合。

papers.title: A note on the $Σ_2^P$-completeness of the Frobenius number
papers.abstract: Given a finite set $A$ of natural numbers whose greatest common divisor is one, the Frobenius number $g(A)$ is the largest integer that is not a non-negative integer combination of the numbers in $A$. In a 2016 preprint, Matsubara states that given $A$ and $k$, deciding if $g(A) \geq k$ is $Σ_2^P$-complete. A decade has passed since without peer-reviewed publication of this result. At the same time, the community has found it difficult to verify this result. In this note, we give a write-up of the completeness proof based on Matsubara (2016).

notes: Thomas Rothvoss 在五大会议有 15 篇
标题看起来不是新结果

analysis.result: 本文给出了给定自然数有限集 A 和整数 k 时，判定 Frobenius 数 g(A) 是否大于等于 k 这一问题的 Σ2P-完备性证明的完整书写。
analysis.method: 基于 Matsubara (2016) 预印本中的思路进行证明整理与补全（具体技术手段摘要未说明）。
analysis.significance: Matsubara 于 2016 年提出了该问题的 Σ2P-完备性，但近十年来未见同行评审发表且学界难以验证，本文填补了该结果可验证证明的空白。
